scope: Self review of 44 native game captures in capture-manifest.json; separate checks of functional layout/input integrity and visual/CJK fidelity. Full game sources match captured source hashes.
observed: No card/board intersection at default zoom
No UI overlap/offscreen/clip detected in after captures
Compact card summaries use explicit ellipsis; complete text remains in scrollable inspector
Four profile contact sheets and full-size desktop/phone/tablet views inspected
limitations: Smaller on-screen battlefield is an accepted design tradeoff requiring user review
